Title: Unsubscribe/Downgrade
Content: Objective Learn how to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to free plan. Cancel Subscription Refund Policy Details 1) Cancel Subscription To cancel the Advanced Plan subscription, you must have the Group Admin/Group Collaborator permission. Make sure you are in the correct Group. Check the Group name on the top-left corner of your screen. To switch Groups, click on the downward arrow () next to the Group name. Go to 'Console' &gt 'Summary' On the far right, you will find the 'Downgrade' button. Click and confirm downgrade. Your Advanced Plan will be valid until the 'Measurement period' noted on your screen. Please note that under CLO-SET TOS, no refunds are made for unused number of days, unless required by law. 2) Refund Policy Your Advanced Plan subscription will be valid until the end of Measurement Period. Please note that under CLO-SET TOS, no refunds are made for unused number of days, unless required by law. For any inquiries, please contact hello@clo-set.com

Title: New User Tutorial: CLO-SET in 5 minutes!
Content: Welcome to CLO-SET! We're thrilled to see you join us. To help with your onboarding, we've prepared quick tutorial videos on how to effectively use CLO-SET. Watch the clips below and try it yourself on your CLO-SET dashboard! Click here to download sample files

Title: Embed Viewer
Content: Objective Embed Viewer allows you to share the 3D view with the public crowd. Share the link or embed the CLO-SET 3D viewer in external websites. No CLO-SET account is required to view the Embed Viewer. Launch Embed Viewer Share via Link or QR code Embed to External Website Details 1) Launch Embed Viewer 1. From the 3D Viewer, click on the Embed button at the bottom right corner 2. Click 'OK' on the pop-up modal. **Please be mindful that launching the Embed Viewer will convert your Content to a Public status. Anyone with the link will be able to view the Content. Be ware of security implications of Embed Viewer. 3. Select show options, logo type, and URL Show Options Show and Hide UI: on the top left of the Viewer. Viewers can turn on/off the avatar and garment. Colorway: on the bottom of the Viewer. Select whether or not to provide Colorway selection option. Deselect to provide only the Colorway shown on the Viewer. Logo: on the top right of Viewer. Select a CLO-SET logo or remove watermark. URL Type Link &amp QR Code: Share the Viewer with a URL or QR code. With this option, you may share the Viewer to anyone including non-CLO-SET users. Save the QR Code with the 'Save' button. Iframe: With the Iframe link, you can embed the Viewer on your own website. Copy the link and paste it on your HTML page. 2) Share via Link or QR Code To share the 3D Viewer with a link or QR code, select the URL Type Copy the URL, or save the QR code to share with your partners Embed Viewer example: https://style.clo-set.com/embed/a1cb83cf1003499fae8c21b2c6235eab/1/c/0 3) Embed to External Website To embed the 3D Viewer to external website, click on 'Iframe' option Copy the link and paste it on your HTML page. Once loaded, the Embed Viewer will be shown as below:

Title: Content Upload
Content: Objective Upload your files to CLO-SET to start collaborating. Upload in Workroom or Company Library Create New Workroom Upload File(s) Upload Turntable Images Create Blank Content Drag &amp Drop to Upload Direct Upload from CLO3D Content Type &amp ID Troubleshooting Details 1) Upload in Workroom 1. To upload Content(s), go to the Workroom or Company Library. *Uploading can only be done in Workroom or Company Library. 2. Click '+ NEW' button at the top left corner. Select upload option from the drop-down list. Create New Workroom Create a child-workroom (a sub-folder within your Workroom) Upload File(s) Upload single or multiple files to your Workroom/Company Library. Find the list of supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. You can upload other file types, but may not be able to preview the file in 3D Viewer. Select the file(s) to upload, and confirm the list and options. Click 'Upload' File Information Extension and file type icon File name File size Do not notify Admins &amp Collaborators On: notification NOT sent Off: notification sent Auto-Naming On: automatically assign Content Name as 'File Name_User ID_date_number' Off: use original file name You may exit the Workroom page once the uploading task is initiated. You may NOT cancel the upload once you see the upload progress bar at the top-right corner. Upload Turntable Images Select the Content Type. Which Content Type is the original file of this turntable image? Select the list of files, and enter Colorway Name Upload Turntable Images Unzip Render Turntable files from CLO or CLO-SET, and select the list of images for each Colorway. Insert name of Colorway Select Upload options Do not notify Admins &amp Collaborators Auto-Naming Once uploaded, review the file in Turntable format per Colorway. Create Blank Content Create a 'Blank Content', or a placeholder for your team to upload specific files. Select the Content Type of the file to be uploaded. 2) Drag &amp Drop to Upload Drag &amp Drop File(s) to the Workroom to upload. Can ONLY upload to the Workroom you are in. To upload the files into the Child Workroom, please first enter the Child Workroom. Upload options (Do not notify collaborators, Auto-Naming) will follow your last saved option. Default setting is 'Off'. 3) Direct Upload from CLO3D Learn how to upload your files directly from CLO3D software to CLO-SET. 4) Content Type &amp ID Learn the classification of Content Types and the naming convention of Content ID in CLO-SET. 5) Troubleshooting Please check your permission. Users without upload permission will NOT be able to use the drag &amp drop upload feature. Permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, Viewer (enable upload) can upload files. If ANY of your file names include special characters, please remove them. If ANY of your file size exceeds 1GB, uploading is not possible. *If any of your files include unsupported special characters or exceed the file size limit, upload action will be cancelled. For further issues, please submit a ticket with the Workroom URL.

Title: Virtual Showroom
Content: Start building your Virtual Showroom, in 360. Publish it online and start inviting your customers online. Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor Pricing Plan: Advanced Objective Find a detailed Virtual Showroom Setup Guide Checklist Virtual Showroom Setup Create Showroom Add/Edit Contents Virtual Showroom Live Download Preset Space Image Virtual Showroom Webinar Details 1. Checklist 1) Move Contents to Assortment. From Workroom, move Contents to Assortment From Assortment, create Virtual Showroom You can only add the 3D Contents located in the Assortment from which the Virtual Showroom is created. You can create 1 Virtual Showroom per Assortment 2) Prepare the Environment Image (Background of the Showroom) Take a 360 image or 2D Image of your physical Showroom. You may also choose to use CLO-SET preset images. 360 image file must be less than 8192 * 4096 px, 100mb. File formats can be png, jpg, webp, gif, or hdr. 2. Virtual Showroom Setup 1) Create Virtual Showroom On the Assortment page, click on Enter the name of your Virtual Showroom. Select Environment Type: Upload the 360 Space Image. You may also use the default preset image. Upload a 2D Image Upload your Logo, and click 'Create' *You can only create 1 Virtual Showroom per Assortment. If 2 or more users create simultaneously, the first version will be saved. 2) Add/Edit Contents 1 Add Space Image 2 Add Contents (3D, 2D, Navigation, and Other) 3 Content List 4 Settings - Name &amp Logo *You may only add space images of same type (360 or 2D) per your selection at the time of creation. 1 Add Space Image You may add multiple Space within your Showroom. Click 'ADD SPACE' on the top left, and upload the Space image to create additional Space Adding Navigation button will allow your users to switch between Spaces 2 Add Contents (Create Mark) Click '+' at the bottom to add a Content. Adding a Content will create a new Mark. For 3D Contents, drag &amp drop the one you want to add, and edit the name and Mark type. For 2D and Other Contents, upload the file you want to add. For Navigation, select the Mark type and select the Space to move to. Edit Mode on Live Showroom [Adding / Editing the Spot] 3D content Drag &amp Drop the Content to add a Spot on your Showroom Hover over the spot to view/edit the details Change the Name / Spot Color &amp Shape, and click 'Save' 3 Content List Click 'Content List' at the bottom to view all Contents loaded on your Showroom, and to edit or delete it. To remove the Content, hover over each Marker and click 'DELETE' 4 Settings - Name &amp Logo Add your logo image on Settings Turn on 'Share Live With Link' option to create a 'Share' button on your Live Showroom Edit Mode - Settings in Live Showroom 3) Virtual Showroom Live Once you're done setting up the Virtual Showroom, click on the to publish it. Once your Virtual Showroom is published, you may share the URL to your customers. Click to save any edits. This will not be reflected on your live Showroom. Click to test the Virtual Showroom before publishing it to live. You may view your 3D Contents in CLO-SET 3D Viewer after it's been published. 4)Download Preset Image You may download the preset 360 background image by following the link. https://drive.google.com/file/d/19ah3pr5RkbGthRiY3sdyWm2yDUh1eIYt/view?usp=sharing 5)Virtual Showroom Webinar Learn how to setup the Virtual Showroom in CLO-SET. Find a local language session on CLO-SET YouTube.

Title: Virtual Fitting
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Plan Type: Advanced, Trial Objective What is Virtual Fitting? Requirements How to use Virtual Fitting Embed Fitting Viewer Fitting Viewer UI Troubleshooting (Technical Specification) Details 1) What is Virtual Fitting? CLO-SET Virtual Fitting allows end-users to create an avatar with user-customized body shapes and sizes, to virtually try-on the garments real-time. 2) Requirements File Format .zprj, .zpac CLO Software ver7.1 or higher Avatar CLO avatars must be v2 and above (simulated on 'Aforsize' pose) Custom Avatar option requirements can be found HERE Simulation All grade sizes must be simulated from CLO3D software 3D Project File 3D garment must be dressed on an avatar before saving a file 3) How to use Virtual Fitting From your Workroom, select the 3D garments that you wish to do the Fitting. (Multi-selection is possible) Click (Assortment) button on the floating menu. Go to the selected Assortment. In the Assortment room, select the file and click (Fitting) button on the floating menu. The 'Fitting setting' bar will appear on the right. Name: User can set the name of the fitting Avatar: Select the Avatar type to run the Fitting Conversion. You may select multiple Avatars between Preset and Custom options. Find more information on Avatar options HERE. Fitting conversion: It shows the number of Fittings that will be processed with the current setting. Fitting conversion is not supported from man garments to the boy and vice versa. Fitting conversion is not supported if the user multi-select adult and child garments at the same time. Time: Displays the expected time for the Fitting based on the setting selected. Cumulative group usage: Displays the number of fittings and measurement period of the current group. (Measurement period: 30 days) 6. Click and a pop-up message will appear. Now you can start the fitting conversion. * IMPORTANT* Anyone with a preview fitting link can access the contents as the garment becomes public content. 7. Click on on top right corner to view the Fitting list. Select the Fitting to view. Next, click to see the fitting viewer. *Please refer to the Troubleshooting guide for Fitting Error. 8. Select the embed fitting viewer options such as colorway, size, shopping bag, capture, and logo. 9. To integrate(embed) the Virtual Fitting Viewer into external websites, please refer to the attached instruction and Developer page 4) Fitting Viewer UI See below for how to use the Fitting Viewer. Fit: View the Fitmap (Strain Map) Viewing Option: Input Your Size / Avatar View / Snapshot / Full Screen Like or Add to Bag - can be linked to your e-commerce website Colorway / Grading selection 'Input your size' option allows the end user to virtually try-on the garment on a 3D avatar. Additional Measurement Standard 5) Troubleshooting If you are experiencing 'Fitting Unavailable' issue or have other technical questions regarding the Fitting Conversion, please visit the below article. Virtual Fitting - Troubleshooting (Technical Specifications)

Title: Content Details
Content: Objective You can edit the detail on each Content. Manage Content information to be reflected on Tech Pack, Line Sheet, etc. Content Details Permission Detail 1) Content Details Content Type : zpac/zprj files are auto-identified as Style. You may choose the Content Type when uploading the file. Content Name: Used throughout CLO-SET features including Line Sheet, Tech Pack, etc. You may edit the Content Name anytime by double-clicking on the field. Linked Content / Notification / Favorite: Linked Content: You can easily check the list of Parent/Child Contents. Notification/Favorite: Click the bell icon to turn on the notification of this Content. You may also add this to your Favorite list. Workflow: Shows the Workflow of each Content. A numerical value from 1 to 10. Creator Name &amp Time Content Information Fields: Manage Content information with customizable fields for each Content Type. Fields can be added/edited in Company Settings. 2) Permission Permission: All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit Content Details / Viewers are read only

Title: Web Tech Pack ▶ Measurement
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Editor Objective CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. On the Measurement tab, you can view the POM information for 2D, 3D, and set Target information. POM Information 3D Viewer Setting Version Details 1) POM Information POM info shown on WTP is from the data stored in your 3D file from CLO 3D. Create POM Measurement in CLO3D. Once you create 2D POM, 3D POM will be auto-generated. How to create POM Edit POM POM List Grading/Base Size Once you upload the .zprj / .zpac file, CLO-SET will import this data to WTP-Measurement. You can add Target Measurement guidelines of Tolerance and HTM Comment and collaborate with partners to make the garment fit the designer's purposes and standards. 2) 3D Viewer View your garment in 3D on the left pane. Select viewing option from the Tool Bar: Turn Avatar on/off Turn Garment on/off Schematic Render Background Color Selected POM from the table will be highlighted on the 3D Viewer in red line 3) Setting Click on icon on the top right corner to manage Measurement Preferences. Select Measurement Type you want to view. Both the 2D/3D POM data is exported from your .zprj / .zpac file Select Measurement Unit: Inch / cm / mm 4) Version When you upload a new version of the Content, information on Measurement tab is also updated. To view the older Version, you may select from the drop-down menu.

Title: Guideline after the trial ends
Content: After the Advanced free trial period, the information you had will be reflected in the next plan. Please check the details of each type of information below. Objective 1. Data &amp Permission 2. No Automatic Payment 3. Subscribe to Advanced Plan Details 1. Data &amp Permission After your free trial ends, the uploaded/saved data during your trial will remain within your account even if the group admin doesn't subscribe paid plan. No change of permission after finishing trial terms as well. But the users under the group cannot use advanced features with Free plan. 2. Credit balance CLO-SET Trial Plan is a NO-COMMITMENT plan. That is, after the trial ends, you will NOT be charged for a new subscription. Your Plan will automatically be downgraded to Free Plan, and you will not be able to continue using the Advanced features. Please note that CLO-SET Trial does NOT include your CLO and Marvelous Designer software usage. If you are subscribed to either software, please visit the respective product site to cancel the subscription. 3. Subscribe the Advanced plan If you would like to keep using CLO-SET full features, feel free to subscribe to CLO-SET Advanced Plan. You may do so by visiting the Summary page on your Dashboard. The Advanced Plan Trial expires at the start of your Advanced Plan subscription. The remaining Trial Plan period will be considered as used.

Content: Objective You can upload a single file or turntable image as an uploaded version of a Content in Content page. Title: Console - Developer Page (Trigger)
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Developer Page tab, you can add API Tokens and Triggers. Trigger Set Sync Set Render Trigger Set Webhook API Token Article can be found HERE Details 1) Trigger [Set sync] 1. Enter the URL and click 'Update' button. 2. Go to style page. You can see the sync button activated. 3. Click sync button to open new tab with the URL you entered above. The new tab's URL contains Style ID, style version, external style ID as query string. [Set Render trigger] 1. Click 'ADD TRIGGER' under Render section. 2. Choose workflow status that fires the trigger. 3. Go to Workroom or Style page and change Workflow of style, and refresh your browser to initiate Render. *Render will be requested with the uploaded file's render properties set in CLO S/W. Potential Error Cases in Render Trigger Fail In any case where render cannot be completed, Render Trigger can not also be completed When file has not completed parsing When file has failed parsing When Render Setting is not yet set Render Setting has to be set in order for Render Trigger to properly work Render Properties of CLO3D Rendering properties can be saved as .zvrp. It can also be opened in CLO3D. Render Properties of CLO3D When your Rendering Properties are established, you can then load the saved Rendering Properties without having to configure Rendering Properties every time. The loaded Rendering Properties will be saved as part of the .zprj file to be used in CLO-SET Trigger. [Set Webhook] 1. Click 'Add trigger' under webhook section. 2. Choose Workflow status that you want to fire the trigger. 3. Enter the URL that webhook will be requested. 4. Enter the Name and Value if you want to check whether the request is valid. It will be added in HTTP header with webhook request. 5. Go to Workroom or Style page and change workflow of style. 6. Webhook firing will be requested soon. Webhook request body sample { "UpdateTime": "2020-07-21T06:25:09.759785Z", "UpdateUser": "hello@clo-set.com", "Topic": { "TopicId": "4ea0710a0e5f4e099d92f7a284d167f9", "Version": 1, "TopicType": 1 }, "TriggerType": 1, "TriggerOption": { "WorkflowSeq": 1679, "TriggerStatus": 1 } } Webhook body schema { "UpdateTime": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateTime", "type": "string", "format": "date-time", "description": "The update time that trigger fired." }, "UpdateUser": { "$id": "#/properties/UpdateUser", "type": "string", "description": "Email address of user" }, "Topic": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic", "type": "object", "description": "The updated space/style information", "required": [ "TopicId", "Version", "TopicType" ], "properties": { "TopicId": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicId", "type": "string", "description": "The id of updated style or space" }, "Version": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/Version", "type": "integer", "description": "Version of style. Will be '0' if topic type is not style.", "default": 0 }, "TopicType": { "$id": "#/properties/Topic/properties/TopicType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "Enum for what the topic type is. 0 is none, 1 is style.", "default": "None" } } }, "TriggerType": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerType", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The trigger type that webhook triggered. 0 is none, 1 is workflow", "default": 0 }, "TriggerOption": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption", "type": "object", "description": "The object information for trigger", "required": [ "WorkflowSeq", "TriggerStatus" ], "properties": { "WorkflowSeq": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/WorkflowSeq", "type": "integer", "description": "Workflow seq that tiggered." }, "TriggerStatus": { "$id": "#/properties/TriggerOption/properties/TriggerStatus", "type": "integer", "enum": [0, 1], "description": "The changed trigger status for triggered object. 0 is none, 1 is changed", "default": 0 } } } }

Title: Category
Content: Objective Manage the Category of your Content. Customize the field names to match your workflow. What is Category? Category by Content Category Multi-select Category Settings Filter by Category Details 1) What is Category? CLO-SET 'Category' is a customizable field that helps identify the Content, as well as filter the Content for a faster search. Best Practice: We recommend using the Category field for unique terms/labels for your team. ex) 'Basic' line, 'Boyfriend' line, / 'Sunshine Orange', 'Midnight Blue', etc. For generic terms, CLO-SET AI-Search will detect it for you. 2) Category by Content Identify the Category of each Content. Editors or above can make changes. Fields are customizable by Company Admin or above in Company Settings page. 3) Category Multi-select In your Workroom, select the Content(s). From the multi selection bar above, click 'Category' Select the Category to be applied to selected Contents.* Please note that the pre-existing categories of each Content will be overwritten. 4) Category Settings Category fields are customizable in Company Settings page. You may add up to 4 depths of Category. 5) Filter by Category Search faster by filtering the Category. Filters are available on the Search tab OR in Workrooms.

Title: Render
Content: Objective You can render the images on the 3D Viewer in the content page. Check real-time rendering progress and download the rendered file by clicking icon on the Content page. Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) Render - How To Crop Option in Render Setting Rendering Server Status Render Preset Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Details Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) The default background setting has been updated to match your Render Settings in CLO3D. You may choose to disable the option to customize the Render background in CLO-SET. 1) Render - How To 1. Click icon on the left side of the Style page. 2. It will lead you to 'Rendering Settings' where you can set the Colorway, Type, Image Size, Background, and Quality of rendered images. 3. After the setting, click 'Render' button to start rendering. *Please note that the maximum image size is 5000px. *For Turntable images, maximum image count on CLO-SET is 64. 2) Crop Option in Rendering Setting crops to the nearest 5 pixels of the 3D content, regardless of what is shown in the 3D Viewer works both in transparent and colored background Style Page &gt Render &gt Rendering Settings &gt Background &gt Crop You must uncheck the 'Use Software settings' before applying the Crop option In order to properly use the 'Crop' option, the 3D content needs to be placed within the darkened frame shown inside the 3D Viewer. Although the darkened frame does not reflect the cropped frame when the Crop option in clicked, the 3D content is first cropped by the darkened frame. Thus, if the 3D Content sits outside of the darkened frame, the render will be cropped. For example, if the render is triggered as shown below on the left, the result will be as the following on the right. Final Render output shown below. 3) Rendering Server Status 'CLO-SET Rendering Server Status' is a feature that allows users to be more aware of their rendering status with the information of server status and their current orders in the rendering queues. Find out more details on THIS ARTICLE. 4) Render Preset For a unified Render output, you may upload a Render Preset for your Company members. Find out more here. 5) Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Basically, V-Ray's CPU and GPU rendering don't produce identical results. CLO and CLO-SET both use Vray Rendering. However, CLO-SET only supports GPU rendering, whereas CLO supports both GPU and CPU rendering. The results of the GPU render of CLO and the render of CLO-SET are consistent.
